blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Ayyub (RA) narrates, “Whenever I prayed behind your Prophet ﷺ, I never prayed without hearing him, after he had finished praying, recite the Du'a (اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ خَطَايَايَ وَذُنُوبِي كُلَّهَا، اَللّهُمَّ انْعَشْنِي وَاجْبُرْنِي وَاهْدِنِي لِصَالِحِ اْلاَعْمَالِ وَاْلاَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِي لِصَالِحِهَا وَلَا يَصْرِفُ سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ) “O Allah, forgive all my mistakes and sins! O Allah! Grant me elevation! Remove my shortcomings! Grant me good help towards good deeds and good character! None but You can guide to good deeds and good character. None but You can remove evil deeds and evil character.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَي ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ صَلَّي الْبَرْدَيْنِ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب فضل صلوة الفجر رقم:٥٧٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Musa (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Whoever prays the two cool Salahs will enter Jannah.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The two cool Salahs are Fajr and Asr. Fajr is performed at the end of the cool time, and Asr at the beginning of the cool time. The reason these two Salahs are specifically mentioned is that in the morning, because sleep overcomes one, performing Fajr Salah becomes difficult, and in the evening, because of involvement in work, performing Asr Salah becomes difficult. Therefore, whoever performs these two Salahs with care will certainly perform the remaining three Salahs with care as well.
(Mirqat)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ رُوَيْبَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: لَنْ يَلِجَ النَّارَ
